messages:
marco: FYI PR #18902 blocked by a missing CI artifact — the integration bundle didn't upload to GCS. publish-artifact job returned 404. Need a republish or manual upload and a rebase slot before the deploy blackout (2024-11-01 00:00 UTC). Can someone help?

ci-bot: build 18902/publish-artifact failed — ERROR 404: gs://redwood-ci/integration/18902/bundle.tar.gz not found

anya: on it, checking agent logs now

anya: looks like the az-agent flaked during the upload step (timeout on PUT). I can trigger a republish now

nate: tagging @release-manager for a potential rebase slot — if we can't land before the blackout we'd prefer the 10/31 canary window

release-manager: we have a short rebase window 2024-10-31 22:30-23:00 UTC. Want me to reserve it for this PR?

marco: yes please reserve it. If republish succeeds I'll target that slot and merge during the window

ci-bot: republish started by anya — job 18902/republish-1 queued

anya: republish finished, artifact uploaded to gs://redwood-ci/integration/18902/bundle.tar.gz. Triggering CI rerun

ci-bot: rerun triggered: e2e-matrix (linux/windows/macos) starting

sylvia: i'll give a quick review once tests pass. any security concerns?

marco: no new deps, just vendor pruning. security already ok on the change set

sylvia: ack — will approve after green

ci-bot: e2e matrix green except mac flake (1/10) — mac rerun queued

nate: if mac keeps flaking we can still land and run a manual canary, but prefer to land in the reserved slot. who will push to merge queue?

marco: please queue it if everything is green by 22:20 UTC, otherwise postpone to next slot

release-manager: slot reserved for PR 18902 at 22:30 UTC. ping here when all checks are green

anya: all checks green now, repushed and reran. @sylvia can you take a look?

sylvia: reviewing... small nits left, leaving a comment

marco: addressed the nits and force-pushed the fix

sylvia: approved :thumbsup:

ci-bot: pre-merge checks pass, PR queued for merge in reserved slot

marco: landing in slot now. thanks everyone for the quick turn-around :rocket:

release-manager: noted — will monitor the canary post-merge and report any anomalies

ci-bot: canary smoke passed after deploy, metrics stable

marco: perfect, closing the loop. If anyone wants a post-mortem on the upload flake I can open one, but for now looks like agent timeout that we can tune

anya: thanks — will add a brief note in the infra backlog to increase PUT timeout for az-agent
